78761.subject: Ownership Coins Go EVM
78761.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

Hey all, happy Tuesday! Today we assess how Robinhood Chain’s licensing fees are reshaping Arbitrum revenue, and examine Umia’s bid to bring ownership coins beyond Solana and onto the EVM after its $6.1M token sale. Let’s get into it!

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

BTC closed Monday down 1.7%, drifting from just above $80,000 to hold near $79,000 in thin holiday liquidity. With US cash equities closed and commodity futures on shortened Labor Day hours, their Hyperliquid (HIP3) markets traded essentially flat (Nasdaq 100 +0.1%, S&P 500 -0.1%, gold flat, WTI +0.3%). 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/23015518-cde7-4148-bfcf-e53cf89fc373/image.png?t=1788865100)
Caption: 

The macro backdrop remains the same one that sent markets across the board lower into the long weekend. Friday's August jobs report came in at 162K against a 56K consensus, with upward revisions to June and July figures. Bitcoin dropped slightly over 3% in the hours following the release on Friday and continued to trade weakly into the weekend and on Monday.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a1d4b2ba-160f-4636-9051-e1580b8ca0e3/image.png?t=1788865100)
Caption: 

In terms of sectors, Monday was broadly red. The only indices to finish higher were the L2 index (+4.1%), Gaming (+2.2%), and Meme (+1.7%), with DePIN roughly flat. The worst performers were the Privacy index (-6.5%), DEXs (-5.3%), Solana Eco (-3.9%), Oracle (-3.8%), and Ethereum Eco (-3.7%).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/52998c31-4fcf-4e40-8284-ac1cebc71ee2/image.png?t=1788865100)
Caption: 

The Privacy index decline is best read as mean reversion after a parabolic stretch rather than a change in trend. Zcash (ZEC) came into Monday up roughly 45% on the week and 134% on the month, having reclaimed $1,000 for the first time in nearly a decade. Even after Monday's pullback, privacy remains the only major sector trading above its October 2025 levels.

The L2 index was the clearest counter-trend bid, extending a run that carried it nearly 12% higher across the holiday weekend while the Ethereum Eco index finished Monday down 3.7%. ARB continues to be the best performer in the L2 index, following Robinhood Chain’s continued success.

The energy spike has revived inflation worries just as traders brace for U.S. CPI data later this week and next week's Federal Reserve decision, where roughly 60% now expect a rate hike. The brokerage sits last among roughly 18 banks, behind Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, but the role could hand its retail users better access to sought-after new listings.
